_note: Canonicalize tagged character names -> canonical (registry) names. Applied at build time so raw scene tags are preserved. Fixes reader-invented surnames and strips pathway-name / honorific prefixes. Add entries as review surfaces more.  2026-08-29: 'Kohler' -> 'Old Kohler' (the text calls him plain Kohler; the wiki/registry name carries the 'Old', which was hiding a 20-scene recurring character in the report's 'minor' bucket). NOT aliased: 'Eye of Wisdom' -> 'Isengard Stanton' -- same man, but the gathering code name is deliberately kept separate (see TAGGING_GUIDE.md).
_exclude_note: Not people — dropped from casts/needs-image list (objects/non-character mistags). NOTE: Susie is a real recurring character (Audrey's dog, later a Beyonder) — NOT excluded.
_verified_present_note: Tags the verifier flags as 'wrong scene' (name not in those exact lines) but a human confirmed the character IS present — named in an adjacent scene or by relation/description. Suppressed so verify only surfaces NEW issues.
